description_en: Queries the areas and countries from which requests are sent to one or more Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances within the specified period of time
description_zh: 查询指定时间段内DDoS高防实例的请求来源国家分布
name: DescribePortViewSourceCountries

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instances to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的ID列表
parameters.name: instance_ids

SourceCountrys.description_en: The details about the country or area from which the requests are sent
SourceCountrys.description_zh: DDoS高防实例的请求来源国家信息

CountryId.description_en:
The abbreviation of the country or area. For example, cn indicates China and us indicates the United States.

For more information, see [Location parameters]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/167926.html）
CountryId.description_zh:
请求来源国家的简称。例如，cn表示中国，us表示美国。

关于该参数的取值，请参见[地域类型参数取值说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/167926.html）
